output.title: podclip – Podcast Clip Generator
output.tagline: AI finds your best podcast moments. Clips ready in 90 seconds.
output.description_short: podclip turns full podcast episodes into captioned TikTok, Reels & Shorts clips — hook-detection picks the moments worth sharing, not random windows.
output.description_long:
**podclip** ingests your podcast episode and delivers a ready-to-post clip set for TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts, and X — in about 90 seconds for a 60-minute show.

**Why clips from podclip actually get shared**

Most auto-clippers cut on silence or timestamps. podclip's hook-detection model was trained on 40,000 manually rated podcast clips, so it finds moments with real narrative tension — the kind listeners screenshot and send to friends.

**On-brand without an editor**

Every clip renders with your show's caption style and framing preset baked in. No post-production, no template wrangling. Just clips that look like *your* show.

**Built for podcasters who publish weekly**

- 60-minute episode → full clip set in ~90 seconds
- Captions auto-styled per show
- Vertical framing ready for every major platform
- 120 shows already generating clips every week

Start free — 3 clips per month at no cost. Upgrade to Creator ($15/month) when clips become a weekly habit.

**Your best 40 seconds, found for you.**
screenshot_order: 1st — Upload screen showing a 60-min episode queued, with a visible '90-second render' timer or progress bar; proves the speed claim immediately
2nd — Side-by-side of the hook-detection results: the moment selected vs. a generic timestamp cut, with caption overlay visible; proves quality over competitors
3rd — A grid of finished clips in different per-show caption styles; proves the on-brand output and multi-platform framing

faq.q: How is podclip different from Opus Clip or Riverside Magic Clips?
faq.a: podclip's hook-detection model was trained on 40,000 manually rated podcast clips — it finds moments with narrative tension, not just loud audio or arbitrary timestamps. Generic tools cut on silence; podclip cuts on story.

faq.q: How fast does it actually process an episode?
faq.a: A 60-minute episode renders into a full clip set in about 90 seconds. You can upload before your post-show coffee and have clips before you finish it.

faq.q: Will the clips look like my show or like a generic template?
faq.a: Each show gets its own caption style and framing preset. Clips render on-brand automatically — no editor, no manual styling.

faq.q: What platforms are the clips sized for?
faq.a: TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and X — all vertical-framed and caption-ready out of the box.

faq.q: Can I try it before paying?
faq.a: Yes. The free plan includes 3 clips per month with no credit card required. The Creator plan is $15/month for weekly publishing workflows.
